title: Sign-in and sign-up have their own URLs
acceptance: Sign-in and sign-up open at their own paths, so an invite email can link straight to sign-up.
Browser Back from sign-in returns to the landing page.
The service-worker navigation fallback still denies /api/ routes, and OAuth and reset-password callbacks still reach the Worker.
The approach is chosen together with the in-app refresh record (RF-129 on PR #657) so the app does not get two routing mechanisms.

evidence.summary: Only /, /privacy and /reset-password are known paths; sign-in renders at /. Checked on main c9b89a7.
2026-10-28 owner UX audit of production: Top priority 7 and the Sign-in row on the missing URL. Browser evidence; not re-observed at intake.

resolution: Duplicate scope folded into RF-129 (2026-10-29, owner-approved phased plan) so refresh-restore and the sign-in/sign-up paths share one routing approach; acceptance carried over.
